mapper.insert: insert into abr_touch_log (task_id, agent_code, target_type, target_id, channel, category, status, reason, content_ref, create_time) values (#{taskId}, #{agentCode}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{channel}, #{category}, #{status}, coalesce(#{reason}, ''), #{contentRef}, now())
mapper.sql: with base as ( select cast(#{targetType} as varchar) as t, cast(#{targetId} as bigint) as id ), users as ( select id as app_user_id from base where t = 'app_user' union select v.app_user_id from base b join abr_visitor v on b.t = 'visitor' and v.visitor_id = b.id where v.app_user_id is not null union select l.app_user_id from base b join abr_lead l on b.t = 'lead' and l.lead_id = b.id where l.app_user_id is not null ), visitors as ( select id as visitor_id from base where t = 'visitor' union select v.visitor_id from abr_visitor v join users u on v.app_user_id = u.app_user_id union select a.primary_visitor_id from abr_app_user a join users u on a.app_user_id = u.app_user_id where a.primary_visitor_id is not null union select l.visitor_id from base b join abr_lead l on b.t = 'lead' and l.lead_id = b.id where l.visitor_id is not null ), leads as ( select id as lead_id from base where t = 'lead' union select l.lead_id from abr_lead l join users u on l.app_user_id = u.app_user_id union select l.lead_id from abr_lead l join visitors v on l.visitor_id = v.visitor_id ), ids(t, id) as ( select 'visitor', visitor_id from visitors union select 'app_user', app_user_id from users union select 'lead', lead_id from leads )
mapper.select: select count(*) from abr_touch_log k join ids on ids.t = k.target_type and ids.id = k.target_id where k.category = 'marketing' and k.status = 'sent' and k.create_time >= #{since}
select k.agent_code from abr_touch_log k join ids on ids.t = k.target_type and ids.id = k.target_id where k.status = 'sent' and k.create_time >= #{since} order by k.touch_id desc limit 1
select exists (select 1 from abr_touch_optout o join ids on ids.t = o.target_type and ids.id = o.target_id where o.scope = #{scope})
mapper.insert: insert into abr_touch_optout (target_type, target_id, scope, source, reason, create_by, create_time) values (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{scope}, #{source}, coalesce(#{reason}, ''), coalesce(#{createBy}, ''), now()) on conflict (target_type, target_id, scope) do nothing
mapper.delete: delete from abr_touch_optout where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} and scope = #{scope}
